nodes.summary: Read the JSON Lines log line by line, ignoring blank lines.
nodes.instructions:
Read the file as UTF-8 JSON Lines. Each non-blank line is decoded as one JSON object; blank lines
are ignored and not counted. Track the 1-based line number of each line for warnings. Support
lines longer than the default bufio token limit. Never write to the log.
nodes.name: Read the JSON Lines log line by line, ignoring blank lines.

nodes.summary: Validate --since and --until as real YYYY-MM-DD dates.
nodes.instructions:
Accept only a real calendar date in exactly YYYY-MM-DD form (reject 2026-13-01, 2026-02-30,
and non-padded forms). Use time.Parse with the 2006-01-02 layout plus a length check.
nodes.name: Validate --since and --until as real YYYY-MM-DD dates.

nodes.summary: Exit 1 with nothing on stdout when the log cannot be opened or read.
nodes.instructions:
A missing file, a directory, or any read error exits 1, writes one diagnostic line to standard
error, and writes nothing to standard output. Buffer report output so a late read error cannot
leave partial stdout.
nodes.name: Exit 1 with nothing on stdout when the log cannot be opened or read.

nodes.summary: Exit 2 with nothing on stdout for every usage error.
nodes.instructions:
An unknown report or option (including --help), a missing option value, an invalid date, or a
missing or extra log path exits 2 with empty stdout. Write a usage line naming each report and
each option to standard error.
nodes.name: Exit 2 with nothing on stdout for every usage error.

nodes.summary: Skip malformed lines with a stderr warning and a skipped count.
nodes.instructions:
Skip a line that is not a JSON object, is not valid UTF-8, lacks a non-empty string in any of
execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, job.target, or whose started_at does not
begin with a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. Count it as skipped and write one warning naming the
line number to standard error. Skipping never changes the exit code.
nodes.name: Skip malformed lines with a stderr warning and a skipped count.

nodes.summary: Skip lines repeating an earlier kept execution_id.
nodes.instructions:
Keep the first occurrence of an execution_id; skip and count later repeats with a warning. Only
records that pass every other rule register their id, so a line skipped as malformed does not
block a later valid record with the same id.
nodes.name: Skip lines repeating an earlier kept execution_id.

nodes.summary: Treat absent, null, or wrongly typed numeric fields as zero.
nodes.instructions:
Token counts, cost_usd, and elapsed_ms that are absent, null, or of a JSON type other than number
count as zero. A record without result.stats is still a record. returncode null or absent is
recorded as absent; timed_out defaults to false.
nodes.name: Treat absent, null, or wrongly typed numeric fields as zero.

nodes.summary: Attribute each record to the executed model, falling back to the requested one.
nodes.instructions:
A record's model is result.stats.model when present and non-empty, otherwise job.model. The
provider is job.llm.
nodes.name: Attribute each record to the executed model, falling back to the requested one.

A started_at that does not begin with a real calendar date skips the line.
Each skipped line is warned about once with its line number and valid neighbours are kept.
The first occurrence of an execution_id is kept and later repeats are skipped and counted.
A line skipped for another reason does not register its id, so a later valid record with that id is kept.
Each duplicate warns once with its line number and is counted together with malformed lines.
A record with no result.stats object is kept as a record with zero numeric fields.
A null cost_usd counts as zero while the other numeric fields of the record are still summed.
Each absent token count, cost, and duration counts as zero independently of the others.
A numeric field with a JSON type other than number or null counts as zero and keeps the record.
A null or absent returncode is recorded as absent rather than zero.
An absent timed_out defaults to false.
A record with a non-empty result.stats.model is attributed to that model rather than job.model.
A record without result.stats is attributed to job.model.
A null, absent, or empty result.stats.model falls back to job.model.
The provider of a record is read from job.llm.

nodes.summary: Read the JSON Lines log line by line, ignoring blank lines.
nodes.instructions:
Read the file as UTF-8 JSON Lines. Each non-blank line is decoded as one JSON object; blank lines
are ignored and not counted. Track the 1-based line number of each line for warnings. Support
lines longer than the default bufio token limit. Never write to the log.
nodes.name: Read the JSON Lines log line by line, ignoring blank lines.

nodes.summary: Validate --since and --until as real YYYY-MM-DD dates.
nodes.instructions:
Accept only a real calendar date in exactly YYYY-MM-DD form (reject 2026-13-01, 2026-02-30,
and non-padded forms). Use time.Parse with the 2006-01-02 layout plus a length check.
nodes.name: Validate --since and --until as real YYYY-MM-DD dates.

nodes.summary: Exit 1 with nothing on stdout when the log cannot be opened or read.
nodes.instructions:
A missing file, a directory, or any read error exits 1, writes one diagnostic line to standard
error, and writes nothing to standard output. Buffer report output so a late read error cannot
leave partial stdout.
nodes.name: Exit 1 with nothing on stdout when the log cannot be opened or read.

nodes.summary: Exit 2 with nothing on stdout for every usage error.
nodes.instructions:
An unknown report or option (including --help), a missing option value, an invalid date, or a
missing or extra log path exits 2 with empty stdout. Write a usage line naming each report and
each option to standard error.
nodes.name: Exit 2 with nothing on stdout for every usage error.

nodes.summary: Skip malformed lines with a stderr warning and a skipped count.
nodes.instructions:
Skip a line that is not a JSON object, is not valid UTF-8, lacks a non-empty string in any of
execution_id, started_at, status, job.command_name, job.target, or whose started_at does not
begin with a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. Count it as skipped and write one warning naming the
line number to standard error. Skipping never changes the exit code.
nodes.name: Skip malformed lines with a stderr warning and a skipped count.

nodes.summary: Skip lines repeating an earlier kept execution_id.
nodes.instructions:
Keep the first occurrence of an execution_id; skip and count later repeats with a warning. Only
records that pass every other rule register their id, so a line skipped as malformed does not
block a later valid record with the same id.
nodes.name: Skip lines repeating an earlier kept execution_id.

nodes.summary: Treat absent, null, or wrongly typed numeric fields as zero.
nodes.instructions:
Token counts, cost_usd, and elapsed_ms that are absent, null, or of a JSON type other than number
count as zero. A record without result.stats is still a record. returncode null or absent is
recorded as absent; timed_out defaults to false.
nodes.name: Treat absent, null, or wrongly typed numeric fields as zero.

nodes.summary: Attribute each record to the executed model, falling back to the requested one.
nodes.instructions:
A record's model is result.stats.model when present and non-empty, otherwise job.model. The
provider is job.llm.
nodes.name: Attribute each record to the executed model, falling back to the requested one.

acceptance.intent: The usage line names every report and every option.
Lines that are not JSON objects are skipped and counted rather than failing the read.
A line that is not valid UTF-8 is skipped as not a JSON object.
A line lacking a non-empty string in any required field is skipped.
A started_at that does not begin with a real calendar date skips the line.
Each skipped line is warned about once with its line number and valid neighbours are kept.
The first occurrence of an execution_id is kept and later repeats are skipped and counted.
A line skipped for another reason does not register its id, so a later valid record with that id is kept.
Each duplicate warns once with its line number and is counted together with malformed lines.
A record with no result.stats object is kept as a record with zero numeric fields.
A null cost_usd counts as zero while the other numeric fields of the record are still summed.
Each absent token count, cost, and duration counts as zero independently of the others.
A numeric field with a JSON type other than number or null counts as zero and keeps the record.
A null or absent returncode is recorded as absent rather than zero.
An absent timed_out defaults to false.
A record with a non-empty result.stats.model is attributed to that model rather than job.model.
A record without result.stats is attributed to job.model.
A null, absent, or empty result.stats.model falls back to job.model.
The provider of a record is read from job.llm.
